cases.sentence: Вот слово Господне, которое было к Иеремии, когда царь Цедекия послал к нему ___.
cases.translation: Here is the word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah when King Zedekiah sent Pashhur.
cases.explain: Пашхура is the direct object of the verb послал (sent), requiring the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Я буду воевать против вас простертой и могучей ___.
cases.translation: I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) indicating means requires the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Я поражу обитателей этого города вместе с ___.
cases.translation: I will strike the inhabitants of this city together with animals.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) indicating accompaniment requires the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Я предлагаю вам на выбор путь жизни и путь ___.
cases.translation: I set before you the way of life and the way of death.
cases.explain: The genitive construction путь смерти (way of death) requires genitive case.

cases.sentence: Каждый, кто выйдет и сдастся халдеям, жизнь будет ему ___.
cases.translation: He who goes out and surrenders to the Chaldeans will have life as his reward.
cases.explain: The verb будет (will be) linking a predicate nominal requires the instrumental case.

cases.translation: Deliver the oppressed from the hands of the oppressor.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) always requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Я поворачиваю против вас оружие, которое вы держите в ___.
cases.translation: I turn back the weapons that are in your hands.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) indicating location requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Я решил сделать этому городу зло, а не ___.
cases.translation: I have set my face on this city for evil, and not for good.
cases.explain: After the conjunction a (but), both nouns take the same case structure.

reading.ru: Вот слово Господне, которое было к Иеремии, когда царь Цедекия послал к нему Пашхура, сына Малхии, и священника Сафонию, сына Моосеи, чтобы те сказали, «Попроси о нас Господа».
reading.question: Who did King Zedekiah send to Jeremiah, and what was their request?
options: He sent Pashhur and Zephaniah to ask Jeremiah to intercede with God
He sent army commanders to prepare for war
He sent priests to perform sacrifices
He sent officials to demand surrender
reading.correct: He sent Pashhur and Zephaniah to ask Jeremiah to intercede with God
reading.explain: The text states that Zedekiah sent Pashhur and Zephaniah asking them to request prayer from Jeremiah.

reading.ru: Может, Господь сотворит для нас чудо, как в былые времена, и Навуходоносор отойдет от нас?
reading.question: What hope do the messengers express?
options: That God will perform a miracle and Nebuchadnezzar will withdraw
That they will defeat Babylon in battle
That Egypt will come to their aid
That the siege will lift on its own
reading.correct: That God will perform a miracle and Nebuchadnezzar will withdraw
reading.explain: They ask if God will perform a miracle and Nebuchadnezzar will withdraw, showing their hope for divine intervention.

reading.ru: Я поворачиваю против вас оружие в ваших руках.
reading.question: What shocking reversal does God promise?
options: He will turn the weapons in their hands against them
reading.correct: He will turn the weapons in their hands against them
reading.explain: God says He will turn back the weapons of war that are in their hands against them.

reading.ru: А народу этому скажи, так говорит Господь. Я предлагаю вам на выбор путь жизни и путь смерти.
reading.question: What choice does God offer to the people?
options: The way of life and the way of death
reading.correct: The way of life and the way of death
reading.explain: God says directly: 'I set before you the way of life and the way of death.'

reading.ru: А каждый, кто выйдет и сдастся халдеям, которые осаждают вас, уцелеет. Жизнь будет ему наградой.
reading.question: What does God promise to those who surrender to the Chaldeans?
options: They will escape with their lives
reading.correct: They will escape with their lives
reading.explain: The text states: 'He who goes out and surrenders to the Chaldeans will live, and life will be his reward.'

reading.ru: Вершите праведный суд каждое утро, спасайте обездоленного от рук притеснителя, а не то возгорится, как огонь мой гнев.
reading.question: What judgment does God threaten if they do not execute justice?
options: His wrath will burn like fire
He will take away their kingdom
reading.correct: His wrath will burn like fire
reading.explain: God says: 'Execute justice...or else my wrath will go out like fire, and burn.'
